vectors.name: detector-local full 1MiB SHA-256 at observer install

vectors.name: Discovery SHA is provenance only
vectors.evidence: real_adapter derives launcherIdentitySha from current TargetChoice measurement; worker independently re-hashes and adapter re-checks returned local identity

vectors.name: same-targetId unsupported runtime replacement
vectors.evidence: stale golden Discovery assertion cannot authorize a replacement runtime whose current detector-local ROM digest is non-golden

vectors.name: Discovery identity generation freshness
vectors.evidence: discover() clears supplied identity_cache at every discovery generation and explicitly treats targetId as non-authoritative across runtime/execution-context generations

vectors.name: current authority status exactness

vectors.name: same-page rebind revokes warning authority

vectors.name: same-worker rebind stops old observer

vectors.name: Worker replacement lifecycle

vectors.name: stale in-flight completion after revoke

vectors.name: disconnect/unsupported discovery fail closed

vectors.name: heartbeat/staleness boundaries

vectors.name: QA seam consumes current production sources

vectors.name: safety and gameplay fail-open
